appearance_facts.fact: The chart title reads 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
The vertical y-axis is labeled 'Number of Tourists' with tick marks ranging from 0 to 3,500 in increments of 500.
The horizontal x-axis is labeled 'Year' with tick marks for every year from 1880 to 1891.
A single blue line chart connects data points for each year, showing a general upward trend from 1880 to 1890, with a slight dip in 1891.
The line starts at a y-value of 1,000.
The line reaches its peak at a y-value of approximately 3,300.
The line ends at a y-value of approximately 2,900.
